data.name: Mughithah
data.long_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Mughithah is a name derived from the Arabic root 'ghth', which means 'to help' or 'to support'. It is a name given to those who strive to aid others in their struggles and provide comfort and support during difficult times. In the Quran, this name is mentioned in relation to the story of Prophet Yunus (Jonah), who was thrown into the sea but was eventually saved by Allah and a whale. The name Mughithah can be seen as a symbol of faith and trust in Allah, as well as a reminder to always help and support others.
